exec git init -b main
at 2026-09-04T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix search-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --type workstream 'Search program'
exec card create --parent search-1 --label selected --summary 'Stable launch context.' --details 'Expanded nebula design.' 'Alpha launch'
exec card create --parent search-1 --label archived --summary 'Alpha appears in summary.' 'Other task'
exec card state set search-3 'Alpha recovery record.' --next 'Inspect the waypoint.'
exec card --actor worker log post search-3 'Archived waypoint observation.'
exec card result set search-3 'Alpha outcome.'
exec card close search-3

# Search spans every record family and every status by default.
exec card search alpha
stdout '^2 matches$'
stdout 'search-2 +ready +title'
stdout 'search-3 +closed +summary,result,log'

# Field, status, containment, label, and limit filters compose.
exec card search alpha --in title --under search-1 --label selected
stdout '^1 match$'
stdout 'search-2 +ready +title'
! stdout 'search-3'
exec card search alpha --status closed --label archived --limit 1
stdout '^1 match$'
stdout 'search-3 +closed'

# The total remains visible when the result collection is bounded.
exec card search alpha --limit 1
stdout '^2 matches \(showing 1\)$'

# A Log match exposes the stable ID for an exact follow-up read.
exec card search waypoint
stdout 'log_00000000000000000000000000000001'
exec card log show log_00000000000000000000000000000001
stdout '^Post log_00000000000000000000000000000001 by worker$'
stdout '^Archived waypoint observation\.$'

# Structured output is one envelope rather than JSON Lines.
exec card --json search alpha --in title
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/title.json

# Literal mode does not interpret public query operators.
exec card create 'Document alpha OR beta syntax'
exec card search 'alpha OR beta' --literal
stdout '^1 match$'
stdout 'search-4'

-- golden/title.json --
{"total":1,"matches":[{"id":"search-2","title":"Alpha launch","type":"task","lifecycle":"open","status":"ready","priority":2,"active_claim":null,"created":1788523200,"updated":1788523200,"summary":"Stable launch context.","details":"Expanded nebula design.","revision":3,"labels":["selected"],"blocked":false,"matched_in":["title"],"excerpt":{"field":"title","text":"[Alpha] launch"}}]}
